premise: On a windy night Tree sorts out who sleeps where in his branches, Owl high, Bird middle, Squirrel in the hollow, and everyone fits with a squeeze.
inspiration: The Mitten (folk) and Andersen's The Fir Tree, turned: the tree does not wish to be elsewhere; being everyone's home is exactly what he wants.
lesson: A home is made of the ones you make room for.

en-US.title: Tree Finds Room for Everyone
en-US.text: {tree:sway loop 0.5} Whoosh went the wind, and the night got wobbly. Tree stood in the middle of the forest, big and old and steady. Room up here? called Owl, {owl:float 0.4} landing on the top branch. Always, said Tree. Room for me? asked Bird, {bird:hop x2} hopping onto a middle branch and tucking his head under his wing. Of course, said Tree. Then Squirrel came {squirrel:hop x3} scrambling up the trunk. It's windy and I can't find my nest! Tree {tree:sway 0.7} thought for a moment. Then he creaked, and a little door opened in his side. A hollow! Dry, soft, just Squirrel-sized. Squirrel {squirrel:puff} curled up inside. Whoosh went the wind. Tree held on. Owl above, Bird between, Squirrel within. Squeeze, said Tree, and they squeezed. Hoo, said Owl, sleepy. Tweet, said Bird, sleepy. Zzz, said Squirrel already. And Tree {tree:glow hold} stood in the dark, rocking his whole family, until morning.

es-ES.title: Árbol hace sitio para todos
es-ES.text: {tree:sway loop 0.5} Fiuuu, sopló el viento, y la noche se puso movida. Árbol estaba en medio del bosque, grande y firme. ¿Hay sitio aquí arriba?, preguntó Búho, {owl:float 0.4} posándose en la rama más alta. Siempre, dijo Árbol. ¿Y para mí?, preguntó Pájaro, {bird:hop x2} saltando a una rama del medio y metiendo la cabeza bajo el ala. Claro, dijo Árbol. Entonces llegó Ardilla {squirrel:hop x3} trepando por el tronco. ¡Hace viento y no encuentro mi nido! Árbol {tree:sway 0.7} pensó un momento. Luego crujió, y se abrió una puertecita en su costado. ¡Un hueco! Seco, blandito, de su tamaño justo. Ardilla {squirrel:puff} se acurrucó dentro. Fiuuu, sopló el viento. Árbol aguantó. Búho arriba, Pájaro en medio, Ardilla dentro. Apretaos, dijo Árbol, y se apretaron. Uuuh, dijo Búho, con sueño. Pío, dijo Pájaro, con sueño. Zzz, dijo Ardilla. Y Árbol {tree:glow hold} se quedó meciendo a toda su familia, hasta la mañana.

sound.note: night wind, gusty but not menacing
